blind.description: A medieval-style wooden and iron signal beacon or tall brazier. It features a four-legged wooden cross base reinforced with iron bands and rivets that rests directly on the floor. A vertical wooden post extends upwards, fitted with iron brackets and three wooden climbing rungs or pegs on one side. At the top sits a cylindrical open-slat iron brazier basket filled with unlit cut logs and charcoal. All geometry is solid, stylized, and continuous with clean textures and no flames or glowing elements.
blind.from_above: A circular iron basket containing crossed wooden logs, with parts of the cross-shaped wooden foot visible underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the figure (around 7.5 to 8 ft tall), and the base is about half the figure's height in width (around 2.5 to 3 ft wide).
